Passage: A Firm must hold capital resources of at least the amount set out in the capital table at all times.
A Firm must notify the Authority within 10 business days if its capital falls below the required amount.
A Firm must appoint a money laundering reporting officer who is resident in the jurisdiction.
The money laundering reporting officer must report suspicious transactions to the financial intelligence unit without delay.
The Authority expects senior management to review customer due diligence controls every year.
Customer due diligence records must be kept for six years after the business relationship ends.
